/** Clean Cart: the look-up frame with its places, search and ZIP code, and the page for each destination. Written by FlowCode from the app model. */
import type { ComponentType } from "react";
import { LookupFrame, type LookupLink } from "./sections/LookupFrame";
import { CatalogSearch } from "./sections/LookupCatalog";
import { PlaceBadge, ZipPrompt } from "./sections/PlaceFinder";
import { useRoute } from "./lib/screens";
import { lookup } from "./app/lookup";
import { SCREEN_IDS, go } from "./app/routes";
import LandingScreen from "./screens/LandingScreen";
import SavedScreen from "./screens/SavedScreen";
import ProductScreen from "./screens/ProductScreen";
import ListsScreen from "./screens/ListsScreen";
import ListScreen from "./screens/ListScreen";
import CategoriesScreen from "./screens/CategoriesScreen";
import CatalogScreen from "./screens/CatalogScreen";
import PlacesScreen from "./screens/PlacesScreen";

const LINKS: LookupLink[] = [
  {
    "id": "landing",
    "label": "Home",
    "icon": "home",
    "mobile": true
  },
  {
    "id": "search",
    "label": "Search",
    "icon": "layers",
    "available": false
  },
  {
    "id": "saved",
    "label": "Saved",
    "icon": "heart",
    "mobile": true
  },
  {
    "id": "lists",
    "label": "Lists",
    "icon": "check",
    "mobile": true
  },
  {
    "id": "categories",
    "label": "Categories",
    "icon": "layers"
  },
  {
    "id": "catalog",
    "label": "Catalog",
    "icon": "search",
    "mobile": true
  },
  {
    "id": "places",
    "label": "Find Stores",
    "icon": "pin",
    "mobile": true
  }
];

/** A page inside another highlights it in the bar (an entry its catalog, a list its lists). */
const PARENT: Record<string, string> = {"product":"catalog","list":"lists"};

const VIEWS: Record<string, ComponentType> = {
  "landing": LandingScreen,
  "saved": SavedScreen,
  "product": ProductScreen,
  "lists": ListsScreen,
  "list": ListScreen,
  "categories": CategoriesScreen,
  "catalog": CatalogScreen,
  "places": PlacesScreen,
};

export default function App() {
  const { screen } = useRoute(SCREEN_IDS);
  const View = VIEWS[screen];
  return (
    <LookupFrame
      lookup={lookup}
      product={"Clean Cart"}
      links={LINKS}
      current={PARENT[screen] ?? screen}
      onNavigate={(id) => go(id)}
      savedId={"saved"}
      search={screen === "landing" ? undefined : <CatalogSearch lookup={lookup} onSearch={(s) => go("catalog", `q=${s}`)} onOpen={(id) => go("product", id)} />}
      place={<PlaceBadge lookup={lookup} />}
      prompt={screen === "landing" ? undefined : <ZipPrompt lookup={lookup} />}
    >
      {View ? <View key={screen} /> : null}
    </LookupFrame>
  );
}
